pipeline.approach: Oral NBD1 stabiliser plus TMD1 corrector
pipeline.note: In healthy volunteers (120 dosed across both combinations) it met safety, tolerability and PK goals and was chosen as the preferred combination. An open-label Phase 2a (AscenSION CF) switching patients from Trikafta for 28 days is planned.
pipeline.next: Phase 2a expected to initiate in the first quarter of 2027

pipeline.approach: Oral NBD1 stabiliser added to Trikafta

Combinations with SION-451 were generally well tolerated in Phase 1, but SION-109 was not picked as the preferred partner and no further plans have been disclosed.

pipeline.approach: One-time eye-injection gene therapy making anti-VEGF
pipeline.note: In PRISM Phase 2b, 2-year data showed a 78% cut in treatment burden with vision maintained. Both 4FRONT Phase 3 trials are fully enrolled. Otsuka licenses it for Japan, China, Korea, Australia and other Asia-Pacific markets.
pipeline.next: 4FRONT-1 topline Q2 2027; 4FRONT-2 topline H2 2027

pipeline.approach: One-time eye-injection gene therapy making anti-VEGF
pipeline.note: The 4SIGHT Phase 3 (N=514) began in September 2026. At the Phase 3 dose, 2-year SPECTRA data showed a +10.8-letter vision gain and 61% fewer injections.

pipeline.approach: Inhaled gene therapy delivering working CFTR gene
pipeline.note: It is the first genetic medicine shown to deliver and express the CFTR gene in the lungs of people with CF after inhalation.
pipeline.next: AEROW Phase 1/2 trial and programme update expected in Q4 2026
